summary: z/OS can't be a control node; on z/OS targets set ansible_python_interpreter to the IBM Python path (for example /usr/lpp/cyp/v3r12/pyz) to avoid 'FSUM7351 not found', and set PYTHONSTDINENCODING to fix non-UTF-8 SyntaxErrors with pipelining.
questions: Can I run Ansible from z/OS?
I get '/usr/bin/python: FSUM7351 not found' on z/OS, how do I fix it?
What causes 'Non-UTF-8 code starting with \x81' on z/OS?

answer_card.title: Run Ansible against z/OS hosts
answer_card.answer_md:
- z/OS generally **can't be a control node**.
- `FSUM7351 not found`: point to IBM's Python:

```ini
zos1 ansible_python_interpreter=/usr/lpp/cyp/v3r12/pyz
```

- `SyntaxError: Non-UTF-8 code starting with '\x81'`: set `PYTHONSTDINENCODING` in the task/play environment (see next section).
